craft_notes: Sthāyin: womb-joy (sauḥ veiled; sarvathā = in every way). Triplet kept. Close: own form. Rejected: naming sauḥ aloud — killed; 'always' for sarvathā — killed: every-way kept.

lines: This is the womb, told in all Tantras evermore —
with fourteen joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma,
O fair of hip, the heart of Bhairava's own form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ yoni samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvathā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ |

reads_against.argmap: This womb told in all tantras in every way — fourteen-joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.
c1_essence: Ever-told womb; fourteen-joined; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.
